title: NIST WebBook: Calcium carbonate (precipitated) is CCaO3, molecular weight 100.087 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Calcium carbonate (precipitated) as CCaO3, molecular weight 100.087 amu, CAS 471-34-1.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Calcium carbonate (precipitated), CAS Registry Number 471-34-1, lists molecular formula CCaO3 and molecular weight 100.087 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 99.9473348 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/CH2O3.Ca/c2-1(3)4;/h(H2,2,3,4);/q;+2/p-2. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
